evidence: In 3d_top and both iso views every body (module, switches, passives) has visible separation from its neighbors with no intersecting or stacked 3D bodies.
Iso and iso-back renders show the module, switches, connectors, and all passives seated flush on the PCB surface with no floating, sunken, or tilted bodies.
3d_top shows the module body centered in its pad ring and every switch and passive centered over its own pads, with iso views confirming J1/J2 sit on their footprints.
J1 opens outward at the left edge, J2 is a vertical THT header at the right edge, both switches share identical orientation, no relays exist, and D1 is the only polarized part.
The dashed antenna keepout sits at the top board edge in front of U1's antenna section and is completely free of components, traces, and copper in the 2d and 3d_top views.
The MCU cluster hugs U1 and the button group forms two identical, column-aligned resistor/switch subcircuits at uniform pitch with C2 centered above, reading as tight grid-aligned clusters.
